grammar.summary: 本课学习属格 no +-ing 禁令结构。

points.title: No + 动名词表禁止
points.explanation: No parking!（禁止停车）No smoking! 公示牌用 No + V-ing，比 Don't 更简短正式。

examples.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
examples.cn: Jasper White 是那种相信古代神话的罕见之人。

points.title: one of those + 复数
points.explanation: one of those rare people who... 从句谓语用复数（who = people）:people 后的 who believes 因 one 而单数——注意实际考点：one of + 复数 + who 复数谓语更常见。

exercises.q: That is the horse ___ won the race.
The only games ___ I play are football and tennis.
This is the hotel at ___ we are staying.
